map.相对风险计算器：输入暴露组与非暴露组的结局发生率，计算相对风险 RR 衡量暴露与: The Relative Risk Calculator takes the outcome incidence in the exposed and unexposed groups and computes the relative risk RR to measure the strength of the association between exposure and outcome, for epidemiological cohort studies.
map.RR=暴露组发病率/非暴露组发病率。: RR = incidence in the exposed / incidence in the unexposed.
map.RR=1 无、>1 风险高、<1 保护。: RR=1 means no effect, >1 higher risk and <1 protection.
map.：暴露组 40/60 发病、非暴露组 30/90：RR=(40/60)/(30/: Exposed group 40/60 ill versus unexposed 30/90: RR=(40/60)/(30/90)=0.667/0.333=2.0. The exposed risk is twice that of the control.
map.：RR=0.5：暴露组发病率仅对照一半（保护效应）。: RR=0.5: the incidence in the exposed group is only half that of the control (a protective effect).
map.由数值序列求样本偏度: Sample skewness from a numeric series
map.RR 和 OR 区别？: What is the difference between RR and OR?
map.RR 用发病率比（需队列/知道分母），OR 用 odds 比（病例对照）。罕见病: RR uses the incidence ratio (needs a cohort and the denominator), while OR uses the odds ratio (case-control). For rare disease OR≈RR.
map.RR 能大于 1 很多？: Can RR be much greater than 1?
map.能，表示强风险；但置信区间宽时需大样本才可靠。: Yes, it means strong evidence, but a wide confidence interval needs a large sample to be reliable.
